PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnE.en: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnE.fr: NINA : Oh, désolée. Je ne peux pas\nm'occuper d'un ŒUF.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveY.en: It couldn't possibly love you\nany more than it does now.\pYour POKéMON is happy beyond\nwords.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveY.fr: Il ne pourrait pas t'aimer plus que\nmaintenant.\pTon POKéMON est vraiment heureux\navec toi.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DaisyStrike.en: DAISY: Dad is mending the fence,\nand Grandpa is not himself.\pPlease be careful out there,\n{PLAYER}. And take care of {RIVAL}.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DaisyStrike.fr: NINA : Papa répare la\nclôture, et Papy n'est pas dans son\lassiette.\pFais attention là-bas, {PLAYER}. Et\nprends soin de {RIVAL}.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpac.en: You don't have space for this in\nyour BAG.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayI.en: {PLAYER}, I don't like the way it\nglares at you.\pCould you try being a little nicer\nto it?
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayI.fr: {PLAYER}, je n'aime pas beaucoup la\nfaçon dont il te regarde.\pTu devrais être un peu plus sympa\navec.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyG.en: You don't need any grooming done?\nOkay, we'll just have tea.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyG.fr: NINA : Tu ne veux pas que je m'en\noccupe ? OK. Un peu de thé, alors…

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGra.en: Grandpa asked you to run an\nerrand?\pGee, that's lazy of him.\nHere, this will help you.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGra.fr: Tu pars explorer la région pour\npépé ?\pPrends ceci, ça peut servir !

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownM.en: You can use the TOWN MAP to find\nout where you are, or check the\lnames of places.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownM.fr: Tu peux utiliser la CARTE pour\nsavoir où tu es, ou vérifier le nom\ldes lieux.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBatt.en: DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had\na battle against {RIVAL}.\pI wish I'd seen that!
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBatt.fr: NINA : {PLAYER}, il paraît que tu as\ncombattu {RIVAL}.\pJ'aurais aimé voir ça !

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAt.en: DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pMy brother, {RIVAL}, is out at\nGrandpa's LAB.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAt.fr: NINA : Salut {PLAYER} !\p{RIVAL} est dans le labo de pépé !

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryH.en: It looks very happy.\pI wish {RIVAL} could see this and\nlearn something from it.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryH.fr: Il a l'air très heureux.\pJ'aimerais que {RIVAL} voie ça et\nen tire une leçon.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfK.en: It's a big map of the KANTO region.\nNow this would be useful!
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfK.fr: C'est une grande carte de la région\nde KANTO. Elle serait bien utile !

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFrie.en: It's quite friendly with you.\nKeep being good to it!
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFrie.fr: Il t'aime bien. Continue comme ça !

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUp.en: It's warming up to you.\nTrust must be growing between you.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUp.fr: Il se rapproche de toi. La\nconfiance doit grandir entre vous.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroo.en:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good timing.\pI'm about to have some tea.
Would you like to join me?\pOh, but look.
Your POKéMON are a little dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroo.fr:
NINA : Salut, {PLAYER} !
Tu tombes bien.\pJe vais prendre le thé.
Veux-tu te joindre à moi ?\pOh, mais regarde.
Tes POKéMON sont un peu sales.\pVeux-tu que j'en toilette un ?

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceI.en: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceI.fr: NINA : OK, je vais le faire beau en\ndeux secondes.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirst.en: DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love\nyou if you raise them with love.\pFor example, {PLAYER}, may I see\nyour first POKéMON?
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirst.fr: NINA : Tes POKéMON te le rendront\nbien si tu les élèves avec amour.\pPar exemple, {PLAYER}, je peux voir\nton premier POKéMON ?

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarW.en: It's not quite familiar with you\nyet.\pPOKéMON are all quite wary when\nyou first get them.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarW.fr: Il n'est pas encore habitué à toi.\pLes POKéMON sont toujours un peu\ncraintifs au début.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMo.en: DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON\nare living things.\pWhen they get tired, please give\nthem a rest.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMo.fr: NINA : Comme les gens, les POKéMON\nsont des êtres vivants.\pIls doivent aussi se reposer quand\nils sont fatigués.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCramm.en: The shelves are crammed full of\nbooks on POKéMON.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonH.en: …Um, it's not easy for me to say\nthis, but…\pIs there some reason why your\nPOKéMON would hate you so much?
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonH.fr: … Ça me fait mal au cœur de dire\nça, mais…\pY'a-t-il une raison pour laquelle\nil te déteste tant ?
